overview_description.description: Shortbread offers a platform for creating and sharing webcomics. Artists use the Shortbread AI Comics Studio, a powerful editor similar to Photoshop, to produce their work. The app serves as a 'Netflix for webcomics,' focusing on romance series and other captivating stories. Users can create comics without needing to draw and publish them to a wide audience.
